mapper.select: SELECT po.id, po.item_id AS itemId, i.name AS itemName, po.lot_number AS lotNumber, po.quantity, po.scheduled_date AS scheduledDate, po.production_date AS productionDate, po.status, po.trigger_source AS triggerSource, po.was_overdue AS wasOverdue FROM production_orders po LEFT JOIN items i ON po.item_id = i.id WHERE po.id = #{id}
SELECT po.id, po.item_id AS itemId, lot_number AS lotNumber, quantity, production_date AS productionDate, status FROM production_orders WHERE lot_number = #{lotNumber}

SELECT po.id, po.item_id AS itemId, i.name AS itemName, po.lot_number AS lotNumber, po.quantity, po.scheduled_date AS scheduledDate, po.production_date AS productionDate, po.status, po.trigger_source AS triggerSource FROM production_orders po LEFT JOIN items i ON po.item_id = i.id WHERE po.item_id = #{itemId} AND po.status = 'MANUFACTURING'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM production_orders WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PLANNING', 'MANUFACTURING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO production_orders (item_id, quantity, scheduled_date, production_date, status, trigger_source) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{quantity}, #{scheduledDate}, #{productionDate}, #{status}, #{triggerSource})
mapper.update: UPDATE production_orders SET scheduled_date = #{scheduledDate}, was_overdue = (was_overdue = 1 OR #{wasOverdue} = true) WHERE id = #{id}
